symptom: Unchanged button specimens and 152 baseline cases differ on the current Mac while structural checks pass.
direct_cause: Calibration only recorded darwin, viewport and color scheme, so it could not distinguish native rendering drift from product changes. Both Metal and default Chromium reproduce the small unchanged-button mismatch.
class_root: Approved pixels were not bound to the OS release, architecture and owning Playwright browser identity.

external_sources.purpose: Playwright documents that OS version, fonts, browser and hardware can change rendered pixels; baseline generation and comparison require the same environment.

invariants: Before comparing pixels, the current render environment must exactly match the recorded approved calibration.
Engine identity is read from the dependency owned by @playwright/test, not an independently upgraded top-level playwright.
Tolerance is not relaxed and baseline PNG replacement remains subject to user approval.

door_reduction.why_not: The shared assertion reads the real environment; its tests independently exercise the reader and mismatches.

generality_proof: Every visual execution and baseline-update entry uses the existing globalSetup. The guard compares the full recorded identity before launching the screenshot browser, so another supported entry cannot silently treat a different OS or engine as the approved one.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Read owning engine/OS facts and reject a calibration mismatch.
Run the guard for every Playwright screenshot entry.
Classify OS/engine mismatch before starting the normal visual lane.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Invokes the Playwright config whose globalSetup runs assertRenderEnvironment.
Shares warmUp.mjs globalSetup; no second comparison path.

recurrence.reason: An OS update or independent browser upgrade can affect every future run without any source change.
same_class_scan: readCalibration callers in check-design-lab, visual spec and Playwright config
Direct CLI @playwright/test 1.60.0 vs top-level playwright 1.64.0 resolution

prevention.invariant: Pixel comparisons require an exact recorded OS and engine calibration identity.
prevention.failure_mode: An identity mismatch throws before screenshots instead of being mislabeled a UI regression.
prevention.strategy: Read facts from node:os and the owning runner browser manifest; enforce them at shared global setup.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removed implicit acceptance of any OS release and engine sharing the darwin platform name.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Keep the owning @playwright/test 1.60.0 engine and existing tolerance. Upgrading engines would itself require a reviewed calibration.
dependency_lifecycle.target: The next explicitly reviewed owning Playwright engine and calibration
exit_criteria: Read the engine version/revision from its owning package
Review visual differences and obtain baseline approval
Record the new render environment and pass a full visual run

migration: The previously unidentified legacy baselines are reviewed against current renders before any PNG replacement. Candidate environment identity is recorded from this host; replacement requires explicit approval.
residual_risks: The original upstream Mac OS build was not recorded, so native raster drift is an inference, not an exact identified historical font version.
Calibration does not prove identical GPU hardware or power settings; remaining differences still fail pixel comparison.
